name: Kagura Shinpuuki ~Meguri no Shou~
source:
Enjoy the second installment of the 'Kagura Shinpuuki' series, where each story introduces a different type of heroine and youkai for you to experience 'cross-species intercourse.' Despite its budget-friendly price, this work offers a rich and intense experience, with a focus on these unique encounters. We have also prepared multiple bad endings for you to savor the deeper sense of loss.

This time, the new heroine is Shinomiya Meguri! Witness how this pure shrine maiden, tasked with exorcising evil spirits, is defiled by monstrous beings... Indulge in her tragic downfall to your heart's content.

[Translated from [url=https://www.debonosu.jp/debo/game/shinpuki_2/index.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
享受“神乐新风鬼”系列的第二部，每个故事都会介绍不同类型的女主角和妖怪，让你体验“跨物种交流”。尽管价格实惠，但这部作品提供了丰富而激烈的体验，重点关注这些独特的遭遇。我们还准备了多个Bad结局，让你体会更深层次的失落感。

这次的新女主角是四宫巡！见证这位肩负驱魔任务的纯洁巫女如何被怪物玷污……尽情享受她的悲惨堕落吧。

[翻译自[url=https://www.debonosu.jp/debo/game/shinpuki_2/index.html]官网[/url]]
